title: 133. Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix

examples.explanation: One longest increasing path is 3 -> 4 -> 5 -> 6, which has length 4.
The only cell is 1, so the longest increasing path length is 1.

hints: Treat each move from a lower value to a higher value as an edge in a directed acyclic graph.
Memoized DFS or a layer-by-layer topological traversal visits each cell only a constant number of times.
